Presentation Command Center

Living Intelligence Database
From random match notes to organized opponent preparation.
This presentation is separate from tournament history. It explains the entire Scout Pro ecosystem: player profiles, match evidence, recurring tendencies, partner compatibility, DUPR-vs-skill probability, projected scores, confidence levels, and development priorities.

What this does for us

Stores every match, PB Vision import, live note, and scouting update so the organization stops relying on memory and starts building evidence.

  • Player tendencies
  • Match history
  • Recurring weaknesses
  • Opponent preparation

Probability model

Separates level truth from matchup truth, then blends them into one final prediction.

  • DUPR probability
  • Skill-matchup probability
  • Final combined probability
  • Projected 11-point score

Competitive edge

The database turns scouting into action: who to target, what to avoid, which partner fits, and what to train next.

  • Target selection
  • Late-game plan
  • Partner compatibility
  • Development priorities

📤 Export Database

🛡️ Safe JSON Import
Preview exactly what a Scout Pro JSON backup will add or update. Nothing changes until you press Confirm Import.
📊 Import Roster (CSV)
Bulk-add players from a spreadsheet. Columns: name (required), dupr_doubles, dupr_singles, age, from, hand, side, tags. Adds to your roster (won't erase existing players).
🔄 Reset to Code Data
If a code update (new match, DUPR change) isn't showing up, your browser is loading an older saved copy. This clears the saved copy and rebuilds from the latest code. Coach notes are kept. Any edits made only in the in-app editor since your last JSON backup will be lost — export a backup first if unsure.

System Info
About Scout Pro

What is Scout Pro?

A private, offline-capable pickleball scouting platform. Search, filter, and analyze scouting reports with full match plans — all stored in your browser.

How to Use

  • Select a player from the roster to open their full intelligence report
  • View skill ratings, pattern library, and match evidence per player card
  • Use filters to narrow by hand, side, region, tags, DUPR range, or age
  • Use Matches to review raw match reports feeding player intelligence
  • Use Compare for side-by-side skill rating contrast and match planning
  • Add private Coach Notes — saved locally on this device
  • Use Admin to export/import the full database as JSON

v6 Upgrades

  • Predictive Strategy Engine — automated match plans against any opponent using observed patterns
  • Cinematic Executive UI — glassmorphism, gold/navy/cyan palette, pro sports franchise aesthetic
  • Data Scalability — optimized search/filter for larger rosters
